propositions: The (inbound, probe) dispatch chain has no live producer because run_differs passes a fetched Jira snapshot whose entries carry no jira_key field, so differ._compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes never emits.

A local ticket whose binding was retired on a confirmed 404 must not be re-created in Jira; the eventual-resurrection path through outbound_differ re-creates unbound local tickets, violating the operator ruling that deleted Jira issues should not be resurrected.

The deletion-vs-aged-out discrimination is implemented twice in the same pass (outbound_differ._safe_get_issue and binding_walk.py:187-196), both verified live on real DC, making the inbound-probe arm architecturally redundant and dormant.

The implementation removes the dead legacy chain (producer, dispatch arm, route, fixture) and guards the unbound-create arm with is_retired_local so retired pairings do not resurrect, with reversible unretire(jira_key) and observable suppression.

ADR 0028 para 2's c244 consequence (same-pass re-create of hard-deleted issues) is currently inert and contradicts prior art (Unito refuses resurrection; Kubernetes ignores missing objects), so the resurrection implementation is removed rather than restored.
